 Yeh Rishta Kya Kehlata Hai Update: Maira Conceals Her Pain Amidst Family Tensions
 In the October 22 episode of Yeh Rishta Kya Kehlata Hai, Maira chooses to hide her emotional struggle to protect her family, while Armaan and Abhira confront Krish over his manipulative behavior.
 Zoom TV Digital 
 Updated Oct 22, 2026, 16:05 IST
 Yeh Rishta Kya Kehlata Hai
 The October 22 episode of Yeh Rishta Kya Kehlata Hai centers on the delicate emotional state of the Poddar family as they navigate recent reconciliations and underlying conflicts. The episode opens with a tense moment between Armaan and Abhira, sparked by a conversation regarding Maira. Armaan admits to feeling sidelined, a sentiment that leaves Abhira feeling as though their intimate moment was unnecessarily interrupted. Despite the friction, the family attempts to move forward, eventually gathering to celebrate their reunion with a traditional Garba performance.
 The atmosphere remains heavy with unspoken issues, particularly regarding Krish. While the family shares a group hug, Krish confesses to having attempted to gaslight Maira, though he expresses relief that his efforts did not trigger a negative reaction. This admission does not sit well with Armaan and Abhira, who later confront Krish directly. The couple makes their stance clear, warning him that any further attempts to manipulate or trouble Maira will not be tolerated, with Armaan issuing a firm ultimatum to keep his distance.
 Family Dynamics and Personal Sacrifices
As the Poddars focus on their internal dynamics, external pressures continue to mount. The episode sees a shift in the Damani family's plans, as Bhairvi abruptly calls off her alliance with the Shekhawats. Nandani later clarifies that this was a calculated move by Bhairvi, intended as a test to determine if Kabir had truly moved on from his past relationship with Maira. This revelation adds a layer of complexity to the ongoing tensions surrounding the former couple. The emotional core of the episode rests on the quiet sacrifices made by Maira and Kabir. After overhearing a private conversation between Armaan and Abhira regarding whether they should continue to trust her, Maira is deeply affected. Realizing the extent of the sacrifices her family has made for her, she resolves to suppress her own pain to avoid causing them further distress. She commits to maintaining honesty with the family, viewing this as a way to honor their support.
 Meanwhile, Kabir faces his own internal battle. Despite pressure from Udai and Purv to fight for his feelings, Kabir remains trapped in a state of helplessness. He continues to insist that Maira still loves him, even as he acknowledges the reality that they cannot defy their families to be together. The episode concludes with both Maira and Kabir struggling to reconcile their personal desires with the expectations of their families, leaving their future paths uncertain.
